The opening sentence of the soldier section is cut off at the start of the source package (the first word or words of that sentence in the original are missing); the translation starts at ...almost visible to the sides of the head and marks the gap with an ellipsis in brackets. In the soldier measurement table the head width cell for the morphotype is unreadable in the OCR (the cell is garbled in the original), so that cell is left as — in the morphotype column. Holotype an alate (female, British Museum (Natural History)), allotype an alate (male), morphotype a soldier and a worker; specimens collected in Tanganyika (Amani, Ngomeni, Mwakijembe, Handeni) and Kenya (Kwale), by P. B. Kemp.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: in Noditermes cristifrons (Wasmann) the fontanelle is punctiform and the postclypeus is concolorous with the head; in N. curvatus (Silvestri) the pronotum is relatively short, only slightly more than half its width; in N. lamanianus (Sjöstedt) the pale fontanelle area is much narrower, and the ocelli are rounder and slightly farther from the compound eyes. Soldier: closest to N. indoensis Sjöstedt, but the latter has a relatively longer head that is concave above and relatively slightly longer mandibles; in N. aburiensis (Sjöstedt) and N. curvatus the soldier mandibles are more strongly curved and relatively shorter (about as long as the head), and the postmental tubercle is only a small projection; in N. sinuosus (Silvestri) the soldier mandibles are more strongly curved and only about as long as the head, and the postmental tubercle is a rounded swelling; in N. cristifrons the soldier head is relatively longer and concave above, with more strongly curved mandibles; in N. lamanianus the soldier mandibles are more strongly curved and relatively slightly shorter. Moreover, in all the species mentioned the frons does not project forwards above the fontanelle.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: (Frons...) almost visible to the sides of the head; in lateral view the head is generally slightly uneven above it, sometimes nearly straight, slightly raised towards the rounded frons, never distinctly concave or convex; the degree to which the frons projects forwards above the fontanelle varies, and the frontal surface is slightly inclined backwards. Anterior margin of the labrum concave, the depth of the concavity slightly more than half its length, the apices of the two prongs rounded. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 6 about as long as segment 2, segments 5, 3 and 4 shorter, generally becoming shorter in that order, segments 3 and 5 sometimes equal. Mandibles slender, nearly straight over most of their length, the curvature of the basal half of the left mandible slightly greater than that of the right, the apices of both slightly incurved and pointed; the tooth near the base of the left mandible flat, larger than the corresponding tooth of the right mandible (which is bluntly pointed); the anterior part of the molar area of the right mandible rounded, the molar area of the left mandible slightly projecting forwards, its anterior angle bidentate, the small lower point sharp. Postmentum (gulamentum) only slightly narrowed posteriorly in ventral view; in lateral view its depth increases slightly from the anterior margin to the tubercle and decreases more abruptly behind the tubercle; the tubercle distinct, square in anterior view, in most specimens the indications of lateral lobing are not very distinct. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave in the middle. Measurements (morphotype/range, 10 soldiers from 6 colonies): head length including mandibles 2.87/2.63—3.00; head length 1.32/1.19—1.39; head width —/1.13—1.25; left mandible length 1.63/1.46—1.65; pronotal width 0.58/0.55—0.58; pronotal length 0.22/0.22—0.29; hind tibia length 0.85/0.85—0.95 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow, antennae milky white, or milky white at the base and gradually becoming pale yellow towards the apex, legs and the rest of the body milky white. Postclypeus about 2/3 as long as wide, distinctly inflated, in lateral view the outer angle where its upper margin meets the head capsule about a right angle; the anterior part with a shallow median demarcation, the anterior margin very slightly concave in the middle. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 6 about as long as segment 2 or slightly shorter than segment 2, segments 5, 3 and 4 shorter and becoming shorter in that order. Anterior margin of the pronotum entire (not concave). Measurements (morphotype/range, 10 specimens from 6 colonies): head length 0.77/0.75—0.81; head width 0.87/0.83—0.91; left mandible length 0.47/0.46—0.55; hind tibia length 0.73/0.69—0.81 mm.
